description:
Activate Krenko by tapping it, creating X 1/1 Goblin creature tokens, where X is the number of creatures you control.
When each creature token enters the battlefield, it triggers Coercive Recruiter.
Resolve one Coercive Recruiter trigger, untapping Krenko.
Repeat any number of times.
Resolve all remaining Coercive Recruiter triggers, targeting any creatures on the battlefield.
